title: ADJUDICATE (human): move bd store off flat-file RMW (per-worker stores + merger, or dolt/sqlite backend)
description: Structural follow-up from biod: the shared BEADS_DIR store is a git working tree written by 7 worker processes + sync loop + janitor, with checkpoint commits and rewinding normalizations guarding it. The layered mitigation (pre-commit hook blocking worker-side store staging + per-branch checkpoints, a158b0ffd7) makes loss practically unreachable, but file-copy granularity remains the disease (worker-4's words). Human decision: (a) keep current architecture and accept the residual, (b) per-worker bd stores with a merger pass in the sync loop, or (c) move bd to its dolt/sqlite backend (check bd's storage options and migration cost first; AGENTS.md forbids bd dolt push — local-only dolt is unaffected). Evidence thread: project-LICHEN-worker6-biod, worker-4's measured incidents.
